check("search([-1, 0, 3, 5, 9, 12], 9)", lambda: search([-1, 0, 3, 5, 9, 12], 9), 4)
check("search([-1, 0, 3, 5, 9, 12], 2)", lambda: search([-1, 0, 3, 5, 9, 12], 2), -1)
check("empty list", lambda: search([], 5), -1)
check("single element, found", lambda: search([5], 5), 0)
check("single element, missing", lambda: search([5], 3), -1)
check("first element", lambda: search([1, 3, 5, 7], 1), 0)
check("last element", lambda: search([1, 3, 5, 7], 7), 3)
check("below and above the range", lambda: (search([1, 3, 5, 7], -5), search([1, 3, 5, 7], 100)), (-1, -1))
check("negatives", lambda: search([-10, -5, -2], -5), 1)
check(
    "large input (1,000,000 values)",
    lambda: (search(list(range(0, 2_000_000, 2)), 1_999_998), search(list(range(0, 2_000_000, 2)), 7)),
    (999_999, -1),

check("search_rotated([4, 5, 6, 7, 0, 1, 2], 0)", lambda: search_rotated([4, 5, 6, 7, 0, 1, 2], 0), 4)
check("search_rotated([4, 5, 6, 7, 0, 1, 2], 3)", lambda: search_rotated([4, 5, 6, 7, 0, 1, 2], 3), -1)
check("search_rotated([1], 0)", lambda: search_rotated([1], 0), -1)
check("empty list", lambda: search_rotated([], 1), -1)
check("not rotated at all", lambda: search_rotated([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 4), 3)
check("first and last positions", lambda: (search_rotated([4, 5, 6, 7, 0, 1, 2], 4), search_rotated([4, 5, 6, 7, 0, 1, 2], 2)), (0, 6))
check("two elements", lambda: (search_rotated([3, 1], 1), search_rotated([3, 1], 3)), (1, 0))
check("three elements, both halves", lambda: (search_rotated([5, 1, 3], 5), search_rotated([5, 1, 3], 3)), (0, 2))
check(
    "large rotated input (100,000 values)",
    lambda: search_rotated(list(range(50_000, 100_000)) + list(range(50_000)), 49_999),
    99_999,

check("find_min_rotated([3, 4, 5, 1, 2])", lambda: find_min_rotated([3, 4, 5, 1, 2]), 1)
check("find_min_rotated([4, 5, 6, 7, 0, 1, 2])", lambda: find_min_rotated([4, 5, 6, 7, 0, 1, 2]), 0)
check("find_min_rotated([11, 13, 15, 17])", lambda: find_min_rotated([11, 13, 15, 17]), 11)
check("single element", lambda: find_min_rotated([1]), 1)
check("two elements, rotated", lambda: find_min_rotated([2, 1]), 1)
check("two elements, not rotated", lambda: find_min_rotated([1, 2]), 1)
check("minimum at the last position", lambda: find_min_rotated([2, 3, 4, 5, 1]), 1)
check("minimum at index 1", lambda: find_min_rotated([5, 1, 2, 3, 4]), 1)
check("negatives", lambda: find_min_rotated([0, -5, -3]), -5)
check("large rotated input (100,000 values)", lambda: find_min_rotated(list(range(1_000, 100_000)) + list(range(1_000))), 0)

check("min_eating_speed([3, 6, 7, 11], 8)", lambda: min_eating_speed([3, 6, 7, 11], 8), 4)
check("min_eating_speed([30, 11, 23, 4, 20], 5)", lambda: min_eating_speed([30, 11, 23, 4, 20], 5), 30)
check("min_eating_speed([30, 11, 23, 4, 20], 6)", lambda: min_eating_speed([30, 11, 23, 4, 20], 6), 23)
check("one hour per pile needs the largest pile", lambda: min_eating_speed([3, 6, 7, 11], 4), 11)
check("hours round up: [7] in 3 hours", lambda: min_eating_speed([7], 3), 3)
check("hours round up: [10] in 3 hours", lambda: min_eating_speed([10], 3), 4)
check("plenty of time: speed 1", lambda: min_eating_speed([5, 5, 5], 100), 1)
check("single banana", lambda: min_eating_speed([1], 1), 1)
check("huge pile needs binary search", lambda: min_eating_speed([1_000_000_000], 2), 500_000_000)

check("search_range([5, 7, 7, 8, 8, 10], 8)", lambda: search_range([5, 7, 7, 8, 8, 10], 8), [3, 4])
check("search_range([5, 7, 7, 8, 8, 10], 6)", lambda: search_range([5, 7, 7, 8, 8, 10], 6), [-1, -1])
check("empty list", lambda: search_range([], 0), [-1, -1])
check("single element, found", lambda: search_range([1], 1), [0, 0])
check("all duplicates", lambda: search_range([2, 2, 2, 2], 2), [0, 3])
check("run at the start", lambda: search_range([1, 1, 2, 3], 1), [0, 1])
check("run at the end", lambda: search_range([1, 2, 3, 3], 3), [2, 3])
check("below and above the range", lambda: (search_range([1, 2, 3], 0), search_range([1, 2, 3], 4)), ([-1, -1], [-1, -1]))
check(
    "large input (150,000 values)",
    lambda: search_range([0] * 50_000 + [1] * 50_000 + [2] * 50_000, 1),
    [50_000, 99_999],
